name: Kalpana Datta
contribution: Kalpana Datta joined the Chittagong revolutionary movement, helped plan resistance, and was sentenced after the 1930 armoury raid campaign.
context: Revolutionary anti-colonial politics in Chittagong during the late 1920s and early 1930s.
impact: Her career highlights women's participation in armed revolutionary networks and the costs of colonial prosecution.
highlight: Kalpana Datta was a leading woman in the Chittagong revolutionary movement.
seoTitle: Kalpana Datta: Woman Revolutionary of Chittagong
seoDescription: Explore Kalpana Datta's role in the Chittagong revolutionary movement and the 1930 armoury raid campaign.
shortAnswer: Kalpana Datta was an anti-colonial revolutionary who participated in the Chittagong movement and its resistance network.
